review.maintenanceAssessment: Retain the reviewed current generator/runtime/build closure and existing automated update/security review. Cached package metadata establishes licences; no statement that historical compiler/test transitive versions are latest or that offline inspection establishes vulnerability status. Framework changes require a new explicit review.

checks.compilation: Current retained NuGet/npm/Maven build and generator checks remain required CI gates; no dependency version changes.
checks.aot-trim: Existing public managed AOT and trim diagnostics retained; no framework upgrade.
checks.compatibility: Pinned generators and schemas unchanged; generated diff and public/internal access guards retained.
checks.licence-provenance: Exact cached NuGet metadata, npm lock licences and Maven POM/parent declarations reviewed; existing runtime SBOM, CDDL option and third-party source records preserved.
checks.security-sbom: Existing dependency review/npm audit/CodeQL and candidate SBOM gates retained; offline policy does not assert live vulnerability absence.
checks.runtime-performance-migration: Not triggered for policy-only changes. Future behavior changes require relevant local evidence or explicit unmet coverage using available tools.
checks.framework-runtime-posture: No framework major change. Future upgrades must assess Native AOT/trim and Android Kotlin/JVM/ART/R8 and transport consumer implications; later consumer acceptance remains WP03/WP06.
